component.name: IPTVPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.m3uUrl = "http://1tv41.icu:8080/get.php?username=3022207888&password=leonmatthews60@gmail.com&type=m3u" m.rowH = 40 m.maxRows = 13 m.leftW = 300 m.cBg = "0x0D1117FF" m.cCard = "0x161B22FF" m.cSel = "0x238636FF" m.cText = "0xE6EDF3FF" m.cSub = "0x8B949EFF" m.cBorder = "0x30363DFF" m.cBlue = "0x58A6FFFF" m.cGreen = "0x3FB950FF" m.cRed = "0xF85149FF" m.allChannels = [50000] m.groups = [] m.groupIdx = 0 m.groupOffset = 0 m.filtered = [] m.streamOffset= 0 m.streamCursor= 0 m.focusSide = "group" m.loaded = false buildChrome() m.task = CreateObject("roSGNode", "M3UTask") m.task.observeField("groupsJson", "onData") m.task.observeField("error", "onError") end sub
sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 624 bg.color = m.cBg
sideBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sideBar.translation = [20, 8] sideBar.width = m.leftW sideBar.height = 580 sideBar.color = m.cCard
sideHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") sideHdr.translation = [34, 16] sideHdr.text = "GROUPS" sideHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" sideHdr.color = m.cBlue
m.groupList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.groupList.translation = [20, 46]
chArea = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") chArea.translation = [330, 8] chArea.width = 930 chArea.height = 580 chArea.color = m.cCard
chHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") chHdr.translation = [344, 16] chHdr.text = "CHANNELS" chHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" chHdr.color = m.cBlue
m.countLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.countLbl.translation = [900, 16] m.countLbl.text = "" m.countLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.countLbl.color = m.cSub
m.streamList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.streamList.translation = [330, 46]
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [34, 598] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading playlist..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.statusLbl.width = 1220 end sub
function load(args as Dynamic) if m.loaded then return invalid m.statusLbl.text = "Downloading playlist..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.task.url = "" m.task.url = m.m3uUrl end function
sub onError() msg = m.task.error if msg = "" then return m.statusLbl.text = "Error: " + msg m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed end sub
sub onData() gj = m.task.groupsJson cj = m.task.channelsJson if gj = "" then return groups = ParseJson(gj) channels = ParseJson(cj) if groups = invalid or channels = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "Parse error" m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if m.allChannels = channels m.groups = groups m.groupIdx = 0 m.groupOffset = 0 m.loaded = true total = m.allChannels.count() gc = m.groups.count() m.statusLbl.text = stri(total).trim() + " ch | " + stri(gc).trim() + " groups </> pane OK play * reload" m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end sub
sub filterGroup() m.filtered = [] m.streamOffset = 0 m.streamCursor = 0 if m.groups.count() = 0 then return g = m.groups[m.groupIdx] for each ch in m.allChannels chGroup = ch.group if chGroup = "" then chGroup = "Uncategorized" if chGroup = g then m.filtered.push(ch) end for m.countLbl.text = stri(m.filtered.count()).trim() + " ch" end sub
sub renderGroups() while m.groupList.getChildCount() > 0 m.groupList.removeChildIndex(0) end while if m.groups.count() = 0 lbl = m.groupList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, 10] lbl.text = "Loading Your Bad ass movie..." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub return end if y = 0 startI = m.groupOffset endI = startI + m.maxRows - 1 if endI >= m.groups.count() then endI = m.groups.count() - 1 for i = startI to endI isSel = (i = m.groupIdx) and (m.focusSide = "group") isActive = (i = m.groupIdx) rowBg = m.groupList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = m.leftW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel rowBg.color = m.cSel else if isActive rowBg.color = "0x21262DFF" else rowBg.color = m.cBg end if lbl = m.groupList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, y + 10] lbl.text = m.groups[i] lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isActive then lbl.color = m.cText else lbl.color = m.cSub lbl.width = m.leftW - 16 lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." y = y + m.rowH end for end sub
sub renderStreams() while m.streamList.getChildCount() > 0 m.streamList.removeChildIndex(0) end while if m.filtered.count() = 0 lbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [12, 10] lbl.text = "No channels." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub return end if chW = 920 y = 0 endIdx = m.streamOffset + m.maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.filtered.count() then endIdx = m.filtered.count() - 1 for i = m.streamOffset to endIdx s = m.filtered[i] localI = i - m.streamOffset isSel = (localI = m.streamCursor) and (m.focusSide = "stream") rowBg = m.streamList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = chW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel rowBg.color = m.cSel else if i mod 2 = 0 rowBg.color = m.cBg else rowBg.color = "0x161B22FF" end if numLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") numLbl.translation = [10, y + 10] numLbl.text = stri(i + 1).trim() numLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" numLbl.color = m.cSub numLbl.width = 52 name = s.name nameLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") nameLbl.translation = [66, y + 10] nameLbl.text = name nameLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isSel then nameLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else nameLbl.color = m.cText nameLbl.width = chW - 70 nameLbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..." y = y + m.rowH end for if m.filtered.count() > m.maxRows hint = m.streamList.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [10, y + 6] hint.text = "^v scroll (" + stri(m.filtered.count()).trim() + " total)" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = m.cSub end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.focusSide = "group" if key = "up" if m.groupIdx > 0 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx - 1 if m.groupIdx < m.groupOffset then m.groupOffset = m.groupIdx filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "down" if m.groupIdx < m.groups.count() - 1 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx + 1 if m.groupIdx >= m.groupOffset + m.maxRows m.groupOffset = m.groupIdx - m.maxRows + 1 end if filterGroup() renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "right" or key = "OK" if m.filtered.count() > 0 m.focusSide = "stream" renderGroups() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "replay" m.loaded = false m.statusLbl.text = "Reloading..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.task.groupsJson = "" m.task.url = "" m.task.url = m.m3uUrl return true end if else if key = "left" m.focusSide = "group" renderGroups() renderStreams() return true else if key = "up" if m.streamCursor > 0 m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor - 1 else if m.streamOffset > 0 m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset - 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "down" maxC = m.maxRows - 1 totalC = m.filtered.count() - 1 if m.streamCursor < maxC and (m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor) < totalC m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor + 1 else if m.streamOffset + m.maxRows < m.filtered.count() m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset + 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "OK" idx = m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor if idx >= 0 and idx < m.filtered.count() s = m.filtered[idx] if s.url <> "" ch = {name: s.name, url: s.url, group: s.group, logo: s.logo} m.statusLbl.text = "> NOW PLAYING: " + s.name m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen m.top.selectedChannel = ch end if end if return true else if key = "replay" filterGroup() renderStreams() return true end if end if return false end function
